enabled.description: Simultaneous Ring is enabled or not.

doNotRingIfOnCallEnabled.description: When set to `true`, the configured phone numbers won't ring when you are on a call.

phoneNumbers.description: Enter up to 10 phone numbers to ring simultaneously when you receive an incoming call.

criteriasEnabled.description: Controls whether the criteria for simultaneous ring are enabled.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number set for simultaneous ring.

answerConfirmationEnabled.description: When set to `true`, the called party is required to press 1 on the keypad to confirm answer for the call.
